svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two flat bars 50 x 8 mm, 365 long, square ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hole: 26 mm, centred on the bar width, 320 up from the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the two bars clamped together so the holes line up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: each bar stands against the inside face of a bearer, its bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end flush with the bearer bottom, its centre 130 in front of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: axle centre line (back edge 275 in front of the rear cross member).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld along both edges where it touches the bearer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 25 mm bar slides through both holes at once and is level.
